rule: weight = G_cutin_weighted / G_courtesy(weight=1): G_cutin_weighted = 2.174 x 0.33918 (docs/r10_weight_rule.json, fix-B term on its trainable set); G_courtesy = geometric-mean gradient norm of the unweighted courtesy loss over the zero-initialised head, 8 production-like batches (4 windows x 120 s) of local TRAIN data; tools/r10b_courtesy_offline.py fit
why_parity: the head is reached only by this term and Adam is per-parameter scale invariant, so the weight acts only through the global grad-norm clip (1.0) and the logged total; parity keeps its share of the clipped norm equal to fix-B's
lr_rule: largest-gain rule: the scale in {1,10,100,1000} with the lowest held-out (episode-disjoint TRAIN) courtesy loss after the production schedule 30 x 4 windows @5e-5*s + 60 x 5 windows @3e-5*s (Adam)
lr_pilot_note: 1000 is the top of the declared grid {1,10,100,1000}; not extended after seeing results
